verdict.rationale: Autumn's own CLI exports some data: `atmn pull` pulls dashboard-defined features and plans into a local `autumn.config.ts` file, a portable plain-code format (autumn-docs-11, autumn-docs-15). The product is also described as open-source and runnable locally, which eases leaving the hosted service (autumn-probe-1, autumn-gh-1). Beyond the plan catalog, there is no documented bulk export of customers, balances, usage events or logs, and no stated open export format such as CSV or JSON dumps. missing for 10: documented full-account data export covering customers, usage, balances and logs, open export formats (CSV/JSON), an offboarding or migration-out guide, and independent corroboration of a successful exit.
